task_title: enforce deploy rotation: check-deploy as a tick close-out gate
task_criteria: A stale deployed binary cannot survive a tick silently: the tick close-out (Makefile target invoked by the foreman/round-up, or a cron check) runs check-deploy and FAILS until ./off-by-one is rebuilt from HEAD and the service is serving it; proven by leaving the tree stale once and showing the gate red, then green after make build + service restart; api-reference/README state the rebuild step next to the run instructions
